# Command

<!-- Generated by `pnpm readme:build`. Edit only inside the hand-written block. -->

overlays · tier 3 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

A searchable list of actions, opened from anywhere with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K. Type to narrow
it, the arrows to move, Enter to run. It loads on its first open, never with the page.

```ts
import { Command } from 'topclassui/command'
```

`getKey`, `getLabel` and `onSelect` are functions, so the palette lives in a client file:

```tsx
'use client'

export function Search({ commands }: { commands: { id: string, label: string }[] }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Search</Button>
      <Command
        items={commands}
        getKey={(command) => command.id}
        getLabel={(command) => command.label}
        onSelect={(command) => router.push(`/docs/${command.id}`)}
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

- **One name.** `Command` is the whole palette. Its parts are not exported.
- **Opening.** `open` and `onOpenChange` from your button, or neither: Ctrl or Cmd with
  `shortcut` opens it on its own. `shortcut` is a `string` or `null` (no shortcut), and
  matches the key's place too, so Ctrl+K works under an Arabic layout.
- **Loading.** Before the first open it renders nothing and has loaded no Base UI. The
  first open fetches the panel; it stays mounted after that.
- **Filtering.** Every word of the query, in any case, anywhere in `getLabel`. The order of
  `items` is kept. The first match is active as you type, so Enter runs it.
- **Choosing.** A press or Enter closes the palette, then calls `onSelect` once.
- **Groups.** `getGroup` returns a heading. Rows with none come first; a group stands where
  its first item stood.
- **Rows.** `renderItem` draws a row (an icon, a key hint). A row is one line tall: put a
  long label in `min-w-0 flex-1 truncate`.
- **Long lists.** `virtualize` is `'auto'` (windowing above 200 rows), `true` or `false`.
  Ten thousand rows mount about fifteen at a time. `visibleRows` sets how many rows show.
- **Paging.** With `hasMore`, `loadMore` is called once as the list nears its end
  (`loadMoreThreshold` rows away), on scroll and after a new query; `onQueryChange` hands
  you the query to fetch its first page. `status="loading-more"` sets `aria-busy` on the list.
- **Nothing found.** The list hides and `labels.collection.noResults` shows, or your
  `emptyFallback`. With `status="loading"` and no items it says `labels.common.loading`,
  or your `loadingFallback`.
- **Focus.** It opens in the input and returns to what had it before.
- **Escape.** It closes one thing: a tooltip open inside the palette first.
- **Position.** Near the top of the screen, so it does not jump as the results change.
- **Arabic inside an English page.** The palette takes its direction and its language from
  the nearest `TopClassProvider`.
- **Other props.** `className`, `id`, `aria-*` and the rest reach the popup.

### What Base UI gives

| Prop | What it does |
|---|---|
| `initialFocus`, `finalFocus` | Where focus goes on open and on close. |
| `container`, `keepMounted` | Where the popup mounts, and whether it stays mounted while closed. |

Inside, it is Base UI's `Dialog` around an inline `Autocomplete`: the input is a combobox
over a listbox, with `aria-activedescendant` on the active row.

### Not built

- The parts as public exports.
- The "Esc" and "Enter" key hints: a key name is English text and needs two more labels.
- `errorFallback` and a retry row: a failed page is asked again on the next scroll.
- Icons by name: draw one in `renderItem`.
- `placement`: it always sits near the top.
- Home and End: the input keeps them for its caret.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { Command } from 'topclassui/command'
```

## Props

Required: `getKey`, `getLabel`, `items`, `onSelect`. Every other prop below is optional.

| Prop | Required | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `getKey` | **yes** | `(item: T) => string` | - | Stable identity across pages, so a row keeps its place when a page is prepended. Client-only. |
| `getLabel` | **yes** | `(item: T) => string` | - | The text a row shows and the query is matched against, word by word. Client-only, as is every function here. |
| `items` | **yes** | `readonly T[]` | - |  |
| `onSelect` | **yes** | `(item: T) => void` | - | Called with the chosen item, by a press or by Enter; the palette has closed by then. Client-only. |
| `className` | no | `string` | - | Merged last onto the popup, so a consumer class wins a conflict with its own. |
| `defaultOpen` | no | `boolean` | `false` | Whether it starts open, when open is not controlled. |
| `emptyFallback` | no | `ReactNode` | - |  |
| `getGroup` | no | `((item: T) => string \| undefined)` | - | The heading a row sits under; rows with none come first, in a group with no heading. Client-only. |
| `hasMore` | no | `boolean` | - |  |
| `loadingFallback` | no | `ReactNode` | - |  |
| `loadMore` | no | `(() => void \| Promise<void>)` | - | Client-only, or a Server Action. Called once when the window nears the end. |
| `loadMoreThreshold` | no | `integer`, min 0, max 200 | `10` | Rows from the end at which loadMore is called, clamped to 0 to 200. |
| `onOpenChange` | no | `((open: boolean) => void)` | - | Called with the open state the palette asks for. Client-only. |
| `onQueryChange` | no | `((query: string) => void)` | - | Called with each new query, so the caller can fetch its first page from the server. Client-only, or a Server Action. |
| `open` | no | `boolean` | - | Whether it is open. Use with onOpenChange when controlled. |
| `renderItem` | no | `((item: T) => ReactNode)` | - | What a row holds in place of its label. It stays one row tall. Client-only. |
| `shortcut` | no | `unknown` | `"k"` | The key that opens it with Ctrl or Cmd, wherever focus is; null for none. |
| `status` | no | `Exclude<Status, 'error'>` | - | Never 'error': with no errorFallback, a failed fetch would read as No results. |
| `virtualize` | no | `unknown` | `"auto"` | Windowing: auto mounts only the rows in view above the provider threshold (200). |
| `visibleRows` | no | `integer`, min 1, max 100 | `7` | Rows the list shows before it scrolls, clamped to 1 to 100; left out, the --tc-list-rows knob. |

Anything else is passed to the root element, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.
